stkh_req__14574330__001.content:
The system shall provide standardized error interfaces that enable
applications to send error log requests and error reset requests to BSW
failure/fault management components.
stkh_req__14574330__001.title: REQ-ERROR_HANDLING-001

stkh_req__14574332__002.content:
The naming convention for error interfaces shall follow the format:
FunctionName_ErrorName_ErrorSts.
stkh_req__14574332__002.title: REQ-ERROR_HANDLING-002

stkh_req__14574334__003.content:
Each error interface shall define the following attributes: Datatype,
Maturation time, Severity, Reset time, Reset condition, Description, and
Dependencies (optional).
stkh_req__14574334__003.title: REQ-ERROR_HANDLING-003

stkh_req__14574336__004.content:
The system shall support consistent error handling and logging practices
across platforms to ensure interoperability.
stkh_req__14574336__004.title: REQ-ERROR_HANDLING-004

stkh_req__14574338__001.content:
The system shall provide safety reaction interfaces to communicate critical
error or safety events from BSW failure management to the application layer.
stkh_req__14574338__001.title: REQ-SAFETY_REACTION-001

stkh_req__14574340__002.content:
The naming convention for safety reaction interfaces shall follow the
format: ``<SafetyCondition>_SftyCondSts``.
stkh_req__14574340__002.title: REQ-SAFETY_REACTION-002

stkh_req__14574342__003.content:
Each safety reaction interface shall define the following attributes:
Datatype, Error list (causing the condition), and Description.
stkh_req__14574342__003.title: REQ-SAFETY_REACTION-003

stkh_req__14574344__004.content:
Safety reaction interfaces shall ensure that applications can respond
appropriately to safety conditions according to standardized protocols.
stkh_req__14574344__004.title: REQ-SAFETY_REACTION-004

stkh_req__14574346__001.content:
The system shall provide mode management interfaces to convey system or
functional mode information.
stkh_req__14574346__001.title: REQ-MODE_MANAGEMENT-001

stkh_req__14574348__002.content:
The naming convention for mode management interfaces shall follow the
format: ``<FunctionName>_Mode_In`` and ``<FunctionName>_Mode_Out``.
stkh_req__14574348__002.title: REQ-MODE_MANAGEMENT-002

stkh_req__14574350__003.content:
Mode management interfaces shall support adaptation of applications to
diverse operational states.
stkh_req__14574350__003.title: REQ-MODE_MANAGEMENT-003

stkh_req__14574352__004.content: Each mode management interface shall define a Datatype for the mode signal.
stkh_req__14574352__004.title: REQ-MODE_MANAGEMENT-004

stkh_req__14574354__001.content:
The system shall provide scheduling interfaces as function calls instead of
signal-based communication.
stkh_req__14574354__001.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-001

stkh_req__14574356__002.content:
Scheduling interfaces shall be defined using the following mandatory
functions: ``void <FunctionName>_Init()``, ``void <FunctionName>_Step()``,
and ``void <FunctionName>_Terminate()``.
stkh_req__14574356__002.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-002

stkh_req__14574358__003.content:
Each scheduling interface shall include the following attributes, where
applicable: Run type, Cycle time, Description, Initial execution offset
(optional), Priority (optional), Function scheduling mechanism, Debounce
time (optional), Implemented ASIL level, Previous runnable (optional),
Supervision type, Alive limits (optional), Deadline limits (optional),
Logical check (optional), and Stack size (optional).
stkh_req__14574358__003.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-003

stkh_req__14574360__004.content:
Scheduling interfaces shall support watchdog supervision in the BSW, where
required by safety-critical functions.
stkh_req__14574360__004.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-004

stkh_req__14574362__005.content:
Scheduling interfaces shall allow functions to declare memory requirements
for integration purposes.
stkh_req__14574362__005.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-005

stkh_req__14574364__006.content:
Components shall implement ``init()``, ``step()``, and ``terminate()`` with
explicit timing contracts and declarations.
stkh_req__14574364__006.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-006

stkh_req__14574366__007.content:
``Step()`` cycle time, priority, and debounce shall be configurable and
supervised via alive/deadline monitors.
stkh_req__14574366__007.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-007

stkh_req__14574368__008.content:
``Init()`` shall read persisted state and configuration; ``terminate()``
shall flush buffers and persist configured nodes.
stkh_req__14574368__008.title: REQ-SCHEDULING-008

stkh_req__14574370__001.content:
Each interface (data or parameter) shall define the following attributes:
Type, Default value, Datatype, Min and Max range limits, Unit, Description,
and ASIL level.
stkh_req__14574370__001.title: REQ-COMMON_FIELDS-001

stkh_req__14574372__002.content:
Error interface extensions shall include fields for Datatype, Maturation
time, Severity, Reset time, Reset condition, Description, and Dependencies
(optional).
stkh_req__14574372__002.title: REQ-COMMON_FIELDS-002

stkh_req__14574374__003.content:
Safety reaction extensions shall include fields for Datatype, Error list,
and Description.
stkh_req__14574374__003.title: REQ-COMMON_FIELDS-003

stkh_req__14574376__004.content: Mode interface extensions shall include a Datatype definition.
stkh_req__14574376__004.title: REQ-COMMON_FIELDS-004

stkh_req__14574378__005.content:
Scheduling interface extensions shall include detailed execution and
supervision attributes.
stkh_req__14574378__005.title: REQ-COMMON_FIELDS-005

stkh_req__14574382__002.content:
If an interface depends on another, the dependency chain shall be
documented within the VSS model.
stkh_req__14574382__002.title: REQ-DEPENDENCY-002

stkh_req__14574384__003.content:
Circular dependencies between interfaces shall be automatically flagged
during validation.
stkh_req__14574384__003.title: REQ-DEPENDENCY-003

stkh_req__14574386__001.content:
Interfaces shall be designed to remain platform-independent, supporting
reuse across multiple ECU architectures.
stkh_req__14574386__001.title: REQ-INTEROPERABILITY-001

stkh_req__14574388__002.content:
The VSS extension shall provide mapping guidelines to AUTOSAR ports/signals
for seamless integration.
stkh_req__14574388__002.title: REQ-INTEROPERABILITY-002

stkh_req__1457438__001.content:
The system shall allow explicit declaration of interface dependencies
(e.g. error dependencies and safety reaction dependencies).
stkh_req__1457438__001.title: REQ-DEPENDENCY-001

stkh_req__14574390__001.content: Each interface shall include a mandatory ASIL classification.
stkh_req__14574390__001.title: REQ-SECURITY_SAFETY-001

stkh_req__14574392__002.content:
Safety-related interfaces shall define fault containment regions (FCRs) they
belong to.
stkh_req__14574392__002.title: REQ-SECURITY_SAFETY-002

stkh_req__14574394__003.content:
Each interface extension shall include cybersecurity attributes, such as
authentication requirements or data integrity checks, if applicable.
stkh_req__14574394__003.title: REQ-SECURITY_SAFETY-003

stkh_req__14574396__004.content:
Error and safety reaction interfaces shall define fallback behavior when the
receiving application is unresponsive.
stkh_req__14574396__004.title: REQ-SECURITY_SAFETY-004

stkh_req__14574398__001.content:
Each interface extension shall define latency requirements (maximum
acceptable delay in ms).
stkh_req__14574398__001.title: REQ-TIMING_PERFORMANCE-001

stkh_req__14574400__002.content:
Cyclic scheduling interfaces shall define worst-case execution time (WCET)
per cycle.
stkh_req__14574400__002.title: REQ-TIMING_PERFORMANCE-002

stkh_req__14574402__003.content:
Mode and error interfaces shall support time-stamping to ensure
chronological traceability.
stkh_req__14574402__003.title: REQ-TIMING_PERFORMANCE-003

stkh_req__14574404__001.content:
The system shall support adding new error or safety reaction types without
requiring redefinition of existing interfaces.
stkh_req__14574404__001.title: REQ-EXTENSIBILITY_MAINTAINABILITY-001

stkh_req__14574406__002.content:
The VSS extension schema shall support optional fields that can be populated
by OEM-specific requirements.
stkh_req__14574406__002.title: REQ-EXTENSIBILITY_MAINTAINABILITY-002

stkh_req__14574408__003.content:
Deprecated fields shall be marked clearly, and backward compatibility shall
be maintained for at least two release cycles.
stkh_req__14574408__003.title: REQ-EXTENSIBILITY_MAINTAINABILITY-003

stkh_req__14574410__001.content:
A validation tool shall check whether all VSS extensions conform to naming
conventions and mandatory fields.
stkh_req__14574410__001.title: REQ-TOOLS_AND_VALIDATION-001

stkh_req__14574412__002.content:
Interface definitions shall be exportable to commonly used formats
(e.g. JSON, YAML, ARXML).
stkh_req__14574412__002.title: REQ-TOOLS_AND_VALIDATION-002

stkh_req__14574414__003.content:
Simulation/test stubs shall be automatically generatable for each
scheduling function and interface type.
stkh_req__14574414__003.title: REQ-TOOLS_AND_VALIDATION-003

stkh_req__14574416__004.content:
A static validator shall check naming conventions, mandatory fields, and
mapping coverage of all VSS nodes.
stkh_req__14574416__004.title: REQ-TOOLS_AND_VALIDATION-004

stkh_req__14574418__005.content:
Endianness and serialization format shall be declared per topic when binary
transports are used.
stkh_req__14574418__005.title: REQ-TOOLS_AND_VALIDATION-005

stkh_req__14574420__001.content:
Standardization of interfaces shall also include coordinate system
(ISO, SAE), vehicle reference point (virtual sensor mounting point,
e.g. for velocity and accelerations), kinematic/kinetic value
(e.g. for accelerations), and signal properties such as sample rate,
accuracy, precision, under-/over-estimated, and integrity.
stkh_req__14574420__001.title: REQ-DATA-001

stkh_req__14574422__001.content:
Config parameters shall include validation constraints and
effectiveRangeContext tied to variant/market.
stkh_req__14574422__001.title: REQ-PARAMETERS-001

stkh_req__14574424__002.content:
Service-only parameters shall be protected by role-based access and audit
logging.
stkh_req__14574424__002.title: REQ-PARAMETERS-002

stkh_req__14574426__003.content:
Calibration artifacts shall declare calibrationId, calibrationDate, and
expiry and be referenced by providers.
stkh_req__14574426__003.title: REQ-PARAMETERS-003

stkh_req__14574428__001.content:
Concept overview of VAPI and VSS coexistence and use cases explaining the
architecture layering of the concept.
stkh_req__14574428__001.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-0001

stkh_req__14574430__002.content:
The architecture shall separate concerns into Application, VAPI Abstraction
Devices, Basic Services, and Platform layers with defined interfaces and no
cross-layer shortcut dependencies.
stkh_req__14574430__002.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-002

stkh_req__14574432__003.content:
All northbound interfaces to the Application shall be expressed as VSS nodes
or VSS-backed APIs to ensure a uniform data model.
stkh_req__14574432__003.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-003

stkh_req__14574434__004.content:
Southbound provider integrations shall be implemented as plug-ins loaded by
the Abstraction Device layer via a stable provider API.
stkh_req__14574434__004.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-004

stkh_req__14574436__005.content: Cross-cutting concerns (time, logging, security, configuration) shall be provided only through Basic Services and not duplicated in providers.
stkh_req__14574436__005.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-005

stkh_req__14574438__006.content:
The system shall support late binding: providers may be selected or replaced
at deployment without changing application code.
stkh_req__14574438__006.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-006

stkh_req__14574440__007.content:
The architecture shall support multiple providers for the same VSS node with
a deterministic arbitration policy.
stkh_req__14574440__007.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-007

stkh_req__14574442__008.content:
A declarative configuration file shall describe which providers populate
which VSS nodes as per vehicle/ECU variant.
stkh_req__14574442__008.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-008

stkh_req__14574444__009.content:
Abstraction Devices shall expose capability discovery including sensor type,
supported sampling modes, ranges, units, and data quality attributes.
stkh_req__14574444__009.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-009

stkh_req__14574446__010.content:
Abstraction Devices shall publish data via a common producer API with QoS
hints (rate, latency budget, burst limit).
stkh_req__14574446__010.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-010

stkh_req__14574448__011.content:
Providers shall report per-sample metadata: timestampSource, freshnessMs,
qualityCode, and sourceId.
stkh_req__14574448__011.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-011

stkh_req__14574450__012.content:
Providers shall surface health state and degradationMode and map them to
error/safety reaction interfaces.
stkh_req__14574450__012.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-012

stkh_req__14574452__013.content:
Providers shall support configuration via typed parameters with validation
against schema and range constraints.
stkh_req__14574452__013.title: REQ-ARCHITECTURE-013

stkh_req__14574454__001.content: Possible example interfaces that can be standardized across the systems.
stkh_req__14574454__001.title: REQ-GENERIC-001

stkh_req__14574456__002.content:
Thermal management interfaces shall be standardized for coolant, oil, and
component temperatures under ``Vehicle.System.Thermal.*``.
stkh_req__14574456__002.title: REQ-GENERIC-002

stkh_req__14574458__003.content:
Compute resource interfaces shall be standardized:
``Vehicle.System.CPU.Load``, ``Memory.Usage``, ``GPU.Load``, and
``Storage.Free``.
stkh_req__14574458__003.title: REQ-GENERIC-003

stkh_req__14574460__004.content:
Network link interfaces shall be standardized for CAN, LIN, and Ethernet
status, error counters, and link speed.
stkh_req__14574460__004.title: REQ-GENERIC-004

stkh_req__14574462__005.content:
Localization fix quality shall be standardized:
``Vehicle.Body.GNSS.FixType``, HDOP/VDOP, and ``Position.Confidence``.
stkh_req__14574462__005.title: REQ-GENERIC-005

stkh_req__14574464__006.content:
OTA/software state shall be standardized:
``Vehicle.System.OTA.UpdateState`` and PendingReboot flag.
stkh_req__14574464__006.title: REQ-GENERIC-005

stkh_req__14574466__007.content:
Variant and feature-coding information shall be standardized:
``Vehicle.System.Config.VIN``, VariantId, Market, and FeatureFlags.
stkh_req__14574466__007.title: REQ-GENERIC-007

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
